system.name: IReNe
system.one_liner: Instant recoloring of a pre-trained NeRF from one user-edited image, by retraining only part of the last layer in about five seconds.

content.variant_note: teaser: two inputs, an opened model box and an edited multi-view output in a top row, then before/after result tiles and a column of zoomed renders below and to the right
content.argues: One edited image is enough to recolor a pre-trained NeRF from every view in five seconds, and the edits can be full-object, multicolour or partial with sharp boundaries.
content.subject: A Lego bulldozer recolored from one edited image, shown as a pipeline, and flower and Lego edits with magnified crops.

lessons.what_to_learn: A teaser can combine a short input-to-output chain with real images, one opened box for the new mechanism and a stopwatch line for the cost headline, with result tiles below as before/after pairs whose framed regions are magnified by leader lines.
lessons.suits: Editing, rendering or generation papers that must show a quick pipeline and many visual results with fine detail in one teaser.

evidence: IReNe enables instant 360◦recoloring of pre-trained NeRFs using only a single image edited by the user (top row).
various types of recoloring are possible, including full-object, partial-object, and multiple-object recoloring.
We introduce an optimization scheme to avoid color bleeding at object boundaries and ensure consistency in view-dependent effects.

summary: IReNe recolors a pre-trained NeRF in about five seconds from one image the user has edited. The teaser has three zones split by dashed rules. At the top, a user-edited image of a Lego bulldozer and a pre-trained NeRF, the yellow toy with five camera views on dotted rays, enter a heavy-framed box labelled Model optimization (IReNe) through thick arrows. The box opens to show MLP bars, a teal neuron layer, RGB nodes, a multiplication node and a segmentation branch with a mask, and its output is the red bulldozer seen from five new views, with a stopwatch line stating 5 seconds. Below, before/after pairs of orchids, lilies and Lego (full, multicolour and partial edits) carry magnified crops, and a right column of red renders shows close-ups.
summary_zh: IReNe 只用一张用户改色的图像，约5秒内为预训练NeRF重新上色。图1分三区：上方为输入、展开的IReNe模型框和多视角改色输出，并标出5秒总耗时；左下为花卉和乐高的改色前后对比与放大图；右侧为红色乐高渲染及局部放大。
notes: No paragraph of the paper text mentions the figure, so the roles inside the model box (teal block, the two RGB triplets, the product node, MLP_s with mask) are read from the picture and the abstract only. The SVG canvas is 511.9 x 253.0 pt while the drawn content spans about 575 x 267 pt (the index aspect is 2.15, the preview image ratio is 2.02). The zones are separated by dashed rules but carry no titles, so they are counted as three unlabelled panels. Colours of the model-box parts are approximate readings from the picture.
